$comment: Machine-readable content-policy rules enforced by check-content-policy.ts (see docs/content-policy.md). Rules scan the shipping surfaces; docs/ may describe prohibited things without shipping them. Line-level escape: append 'content-policy-allow:<rule-id>'.

rules.description: The private career-portfolio repository must never be referenced from shipped content
Personal phone numbers must not be published
Full postcodes (precise location) must not be published — city-level only
Salary details must not be published
Only the approved public contact address may appear (fail-closed allowlist)
Built output must reference only the canonical origin (enabled at domain cutover)
